hypothesis: A deterministic 50% shrink of selected A's composite toward its own provided-feature prediction mean within each official region is a predeclared lower-within-region-variance robustness companion; no claim that it will score better.

selection_of_A.rule: Frozen final-two protocol's lowest eligible frozen-cohort public RMSE outside pairwise-noise ties; V2 beats A1 by 0.004898951, beyond the frozen 0.003308293 pairwise guard. Public results determine A only as authorized; no coefficients are fitted from scores.

fixed_recipe.composite_formula: B_i = 0.5 * A_i + 0.5 * mean(A_j for official tracts j in i's region)
fixed_recipe.regional_mean: arithmetic mean of V2_model.coverage_gap_score over the 9,379 official tracts in that region only
fixed_recipe.other_component_columns: copy V2_model transport_gap, building_gap, and poi_gap unchanged; the frozen B rule applies to the composite score only
fixed_recipe.clipping: clip only coverage_gap_score to [0,1]; observed 0 clipped values
fixed_recipe.template_only_rows: set every score field to established deterministic zero fill for 415 eastern-wa format-only rows

forecast.basis: Steward-approved C0 historical public-RMSE prior retained by final-two calibration protocol; this is not a candidate-specific accuracy estimate or local held-out score.
